title: Imperative 2: Consonant Stem + Stressed -и (говори, пиши)
titleRussian: Повелительное наклонение 2: согласная основа + ударное -и (говори, пиши)
description: When the verb stem ends in a consonant and the я-form ending is stressed (говорю́, пишу́, иду́, куплю́), the 2sg command adds -и: говори, пиши, иди, купи.
descriptionRussian: Если основа оканчивается на согласный, а окончание формы я ударное (говорю́, пишу́, иду́, куплю́), повелительная форма получает -и: говори, пиши, иди, купи.
intro: Consonant stems split into two groups, and this lesson takes the first of them. What decides the split is where the stress falls in the я-form, which means you have to know how a verb sounds before you can command with it. Lesson 3 gives you the other half of that test. For now, every verb here stresses its ending.
rules: To build the -и command: take the они form, drop the ending to find the stem, and if the stem ends in a consonant, add -и.
Use -и (not -ь) when the я form has a stressed ending: говорю́ → говори, пишу́ → пиши, иду́ → иди, куплю́ → купи.
Build the stem from the они form, not the infinitive: писать → они пи́шут → stem пиш- → пиши (not писи).
More -и verbs: проси (просить, я прошу́), смотри (смотреть, я смотрю́), плати (платить, я плачу́), люби (любить, я люблю́).
examples: Говори громче, пожалуйста. (Speak louder, please.) stem говор- + stressed -и (я говорю́).
Пиши мне каждый день. (Write to me every day.) stem пиш- (from они пи́шут) + stressed -и (я пишу́).
Иди домой, уже поздно. (Go home, it is late already.) stem ид- + stressed -и (я иду́).
Купи хлеб в магазине. (Buy bread at the shop.) stem куп- + stressed -и (я куплю́).
Смотри на доску. (Look at the board.) stem смотр- + stressed -и (я смотрю́).
Проси помощи, если трудно. (Ask for help if it is hard.) stem прос- + stressed -и (я прошу́).

tables.title: Building the -и Command: Infinitive → я form → Command

items.promptEnglish: Speak louder, I can't hear well!
items.hint: Stem говор- ends in a consonant. The я form говорю́ is stressed.
items.explanation: Говорить has a consonant stem (говор-) and a stressed я form (говорю́), so the command adds -и: говори. Говорь with -ь is for verbs whose я form is unstressed (that is Lesson 3).

items.promptEnglish: Write me a letter when you arrive.
items.hint: The они form is пи́шут, so the stem is пиш-. The я form пишу́ is stressed.
items.explanation: Build the stem from the они form: пи́шут → пиш-. The я form пишу́ is stressed, so the command adds -и: пиши. Писи is wrong because the stem comes from пи́шут (пиш-), not from the infinitive писать.

items.hint: Stem ид- (from они иду́т) ends in a consonant. The я form иду́ is stressed.
items.explanation: Идти has the consonant stem ид- (они иду́т) and a stressed я form (иду́), so the command is иди. Идь does not exist; -ь would only appear if the я form were unstressed.

items.promptEnglish: Buy bread and milk at the shop.
items.hint: Stem куп- ends in a consonant. The я form куплю́ is stressed.
items.explanation: Купить has the consonant stem куп- and a stressed я form (куплю́), so the command adds -и: купи. Купь with -ь is wrong because the я form is stressed.

items.promptEnglish: Look at the board, everything is written there.
items.hint: Stem смотр- ends in a consonant. The я form смотрю́ is stressed.
items.explanation: Смотреть has the consonant stem смотр- and a stressed я form (смотрю́), so the command is смотри. Смотрь with -ь is wrong here; -ь needs an unstressed я form.

items.promptEnglish: Ask for help if it gets hard.
items.hint: Stem прос- ends in a consonant. The я form прошу́ is stressed.
items.explanation: Просить has the consonant stem прос- and a stressed я form (прошу́), so the command adds -и: проси. Note the stem прос- comes from они про́сят; the я form прошу́ shows a changed consonant, but that does not affect the command.

blanks: _____ медленнее, я записываю! (Speak more slowly, I'm writing it down!)
_____ мне на этой неделе. (Write to me this week.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Both verbs have a consonant stem and a stressed я form (говорю́, пишу́), so both commands add -и: говори, пиши. Говорь and писи are the wrong forms: -ь needs an unstressed я form, and пиши is built from the они stem пиш-, not from писать.

errorCorrection.sentence: Говорь чуть тише, дети уже спят.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Speak a bit more quietly, the children are already asleep.
errorCorrection.explanation: Говорить has a consonant stem (говор-) and a stressed я form (говорю́), so the command takes -и: говори. The ending -ь (говорь) belongs only to verbs whose я form is unstressed, which is not the case here.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Buy the tickets in advance, please.
errorCorrection.explanation: Купить has a consonant stem (куп-) and a stressed я form (куплю́), so the command takes -и: купи. The ending -ь is reserved for verbs whose я form is unstressed; here куплю́ is stressed, so -и is correct.

errorCorrection.sentence: Иди медленно и держь сумку крепко.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Walk slowly and hold the bag tightly.
errorCorrection.explanation: Держать has a consonant stem (держ-) and a stressed я form (держу́), so the command takes -и: держи. The ending -ь needs an unstressed я form, which держу́ is not.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Write to me more often, I miss you.
errorCorrection.explanation: Build the command from the они stem: они пи́шут → пиш-. With a stressed я form (пишу́), the command is пиши. Писи uses the wrong stem, taken from the infinitive писать instead of пи́шут.

minimalPairs.explanation: Говорить has a stressed я form (говорю́), so the consonant-stem command takes -и: говори. Говорь with -ь would only fit a verb whose я form is unstressed. The stress in the я form is the test.
Купить has a stressed я form (куплю́), so the command takes -и: купи. Купь with -ь would need an unstressed я form, which is not the case here.

sentenceBuilding.hint: Command first: пиши (stem пиш- + stressed -и). Then the rest.

reviewVocab.definition: speak! / talk! - command to one person; consonant stem говор- plus stressed -и (я говорю́)
write! - command to one person; stem пиш- from они пи́шут plus stressed -и (я пишу́)
go! / buy! - commands to one person; consonant stems ид-, куп- plus stressed -и (я иду́, я куплю́)
reviewVocab.example: Иди домой и купи хлеб по дороге.
